bagPolicy.summary: All guests and bags are screened before entry. Review the current official allowed/prohibited-items list before packing, because festival security may refuse or dispose of noncompliant items.
bagPolicy.note: The 2026 FAQ and first-timer guide are the source of truth for event entry rules.

parking.note: Riot Fest strongly recommends CTA, bicycle, taxi, or rideshare instead of neighborhood parking. The main entrance is at W. Ogden Ave. and S. Sacramento Dr.; complimentary ADA parking is along S. Sacramento Dr. across from that entrance and requires a valid placard or plate.
lots: ADA parking along S. Sacramento Dr.

rideshare.note: Riot Fest recommends cab or rideshare service to Douglass Park. Use the main entrance area at W. Ogden Ave. and S. Sacramento Dr. and follow event-day traffic controls in the app.

concessions.note: Food, beverage, and retail vendors operate throughout the festival; free water refill stations are provided. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ areas include dedicated food and bar options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The grounds include accessible routes linking parking, entrances, stages, viewing areas, vendors, and activity areas. Free first-come ADA parking is across from the main entrance on S. Sacramento Dr.; a verified placard or license plate is required.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: GA tickets permit one entry per day and do not include same-day re-entry. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ wristbands permit re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: GA tickets are electronic and can be scanned at the gate. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ wristbands may be shipped or held for will call according to the order confirmation; the main box office is near S. Sacramento Blvd. and W. Ogden Ave.

gates.title: Entrance & Gates
gates.body: The 2026 main entrance and box office are near S. Sacramento Blvd. and W. Ogden Ave. Main gates are scheduled to open at 11:00 a.m. each festival day, subject to change.

bagPolicy.summary: ESSENCE Festival spans multiple venues, so there is not one bag rule for the entire weekend. The Caesars Superdome evening concert series requires stadium-compliant clear bags; daytime Convention Center rules can differ.
bagPolicy.note: Check the E360 app and the rules for the specific ESSENCE event/venue you are attending.

parking.note: Ample parking is available at the Convention Center for a daily fee, but overnight parking is prohibited. ADA parking is available, and specific needs can be addressed via email.

rideshare.note: If arriving or departing by taxi or rideshare, use the designated Taxi/Rideshare Zone.

concessions.note: The venue features Dutch’s Corner, an in-house convenience store located next to the UPS Store in Lobby E. It offers a variety of snacks and beverages for attendees.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Essence Festival of Culture, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Essence Festival of Culture's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Essence Festival of Culture. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

bagPolicy.summary: SXSW bag policies vary by venue. Attendees are encouraged to travel light; luggage and large cases are not permitted, and larger bags may be inspected. Major Film & TV and Music Festival venues publish their own size/clear-bag limits.
bagPolicy.note: Always check the specific official venue policy before entry.

parking.note: Driving and parking in downtown Austin during SXSW can be expensive and time-consuming due to street closures and increased traffic. It is recommended to use alternative transportation options like walking, shuttles, or rideshares.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive)'s current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability varies across SXSW venues and activations. Check the individual venue or event listing rather than relying on one festival-wide concessions menu.

parking.note: Festival organizers encourage the use of rideshare, SpotHero, or public parking options. Reserve parking in advance through SpotHero for convenience and affordability.

bagPolicy.note: No current Made in America edition is posted. Historical festival rules should not be assumed to apply to a future event; use the official site if a new edition is announced.

parking.note: No current festival transportation or parking plan is published. Do not use unrelated museum directions as festival guidance; consult the official event site if a new edition is announced.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Made in America's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The National Constitution Center offers a variety of food and beverage options including Delegates' Cafe and Starbucks. Delegates' Cafe features salads, sandwiches, and daily specials like Philly cheesesteaks, while Starbucks provides handcrafted beverages and premium teas. Catering and boxed lunch options are available for groups.
